message.content: {"final_answer": "[罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪<eoa>"}
message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant, as manager of a company, knowingly issued false VAT special invoices (增值税专用发票) without actual goods transaction, to obtain opening invoice fees, and the buyer used them to claim export tax refunds, defrauding the state of about 330k RMB. The company issued 22 false invoices totaling 350,620.25 RMB. The defendant is the responsible person. The crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (Crime of issuing false VAT special invoices). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 205? Actually article 205 of Criminal Law (formerly article 205) deals with "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also possibly "骗取出口退税罪"? But the defendant is the issuer, not the buyer. The buyer used the invoices to claim refunds, but the defendant's conduct is issuing false invoices. So the charge is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also possibly "偷税漏税罪"? But the law specifically addresses false invoicing. So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪<eoa>.
